name: What should I prepare before room remodeling work starts?

mainEntity.name: What should I prepare before room remodeling work starts?

acceptedAnswer.text: Before remodeling begins, clear the room of all personal belongings, wall decor, and loose furniture. If large furniture cannot be removed from the house, confirm whether it can be safely staged and masked within an adjacent area. You should also evaluate your functional needs, such as lighting placement, trim styles, or specific accessibility features like widened doorways or zero-threshold transitions. Gathering reference ideas for molding profiles, flooring types, or paint finishes helps your contractor plan material orders accurately and coordinate sub-trades efficiently before demolition starts.
acceptedAnswer.description: Clear the room of all personal items and furnishings, plan access paths, and define your preferences for trim, lighting placement, and paint colors before work begins.
